description: Self-hosted Nextcloud 31 OCS API across every enabled app: sharing (public links, email and federated shares), users and groups, notifications, status, reminders, search, task processing, webhooks and more. Sharing, mail-sending, push notifications, webhooks and federation calls are held for approval. The WebDAV files layer (list, download, upload, move, copy, delete) is not covered yet; it needs engine support.
